name: Boss Energy
old_description: Boss Energy specializes in Tesla home charger installation, including Tesla Wall Connectors, as well as universal EV chargers compatible with all electric vehicles.
about:
Boss Energy operates from Charleston, South Carolina, serving customers across the Southeast including North Carolina, South Carolina, and Georgia. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in the available sources.

The firm provides turnkey installation services for residential renewable energy systems. Its core offerings include solar panel installation and maintenance, electric vehicle charging station installation — specializing in Tesla Wall Connectors and universal chargers compatible with all EVs — and battery storage integration using products such as Tesla Powerwall 3, Enphase, and FranklinWH systems. Generator installation is also listed among its services. Project teams referenced in customer feedback include James, Alexandria, Jared, Heather, and Chad Antos, indicating a hands-on field crew.

The primary customer base consists of homeowners transitioning from fossil fuels to renewable energy. Reviews describe projects ranging from rooftop solar arrays paired with multiple Tesla Powerwalls and universal EV chargers, to Enphase and FranklinWH battery backup designs for cabins, as well as standalone 240‑volt circuit work for hot tubs and EV chargers. The company positions itself as a single point of contact for solar, charging, and storage needs.

Boss Energy emphasizes comprehensive knowledge across all three technology categories — solar, EV charging, and battery storage — and highlights responsiveness and adaptability when field conditions change. Customer testimonials cite quick communication, willingness to take over stalled projects from other providers, and a commitment to seeing complex, multi‑gateway installations through to completion.

Specialization in Tesla Wall Connector and universal EV charger installation
Experience with Tesla Powerwall 3, Enphase, and FranklinWH battery systems

name: Brackenfern Woodworking & Carpentry
old_description: Brackenfern Woodworking is located in South Burlington, Vermont and has been in business since 1995.
about:
Brackenfern Woodworking & Carpentry operates from South Burlington, Vermont, where it has been serving clients since 1995. The business was founded by Dan, who remains the proprietor and primary point of contact for projects, and he emphasizes a personal response to every inquiry.

The shop specializes in custom interior woodworking and finish carpentry, including cabinet making, the production of heirloom-quality furniture, and furniture refinishing and restoration. Projects range from built-in cabinetry to the reproduction of antique pieces, such as a recent commission to replicate 100-year-old cabinetry in quarter-sawn fir for a client in Jeffersonville.

The company works with residential and commercial customers throughout Vermont, delivering tailored wood products for home renovations, historical restorations, and custom furniture needs. Its portfolio includes both new builds and the careful restoration of existing pieces. The shop also takes on specialized reproduction work, matching historical profiles and finishes, as demonstrated by the Jeffersonville project.

Brackenfern emphasizes Vermont-made craftsmanship built to last for generations, and Dan notes that inquiries are typically answered within 24 to 48 hours.

name: Bradley Fabrication
old_description: YOUR TRUSTED & LOCAL PARTNER FOR ALL YOUR WELDING & FABRICATION NEEDS!
about:
Bradley Fabrication operates from Roseburg, Oregon. The company is family-owned and operated, founded by Chris, and serves as a local welding and fabrication shop for homes and businesses in the surrounding area. No founding year is disclosed.

The shop provides custom welding, fabrication, CNC plasma cutting, and mobile welding services. They work with mild steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, producing items such as driveway gates, iron fences, handrails, and custom signage. The facility includes a fully equipped workshop and CNC plasma cutting machinery capable of both prototype and production runs. Headcount and facility size are not disclosed.

Customers range from residential homeowners to commercial contractors and local businesses. Examples include a fence company (Fence Chuck), a car wash business, and various homeowners needing handrails, gates, and stairs. The company serves the Roseburg area and surrounding communities.

The company emphasizes its family-owned roots, constant client communication, on-site mobile welding, and a warranty that promises prompt repair of any issues. It holds a Construction Contractors Board license (CCB #233694) and positions itself as a local partner committed to craftsmanship and integrity.

name: Brand Bros Boise
old_description: Custom apparel, signs, printing and promotional products for Boise businesses and companies expanding into Idaho.
about:
Brand Bros Boise operates from Meridian, Idaho, serving businesses throughout the Treasure Valley. The company’s founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides a range of branding and production services under one roof. Its core capabilities include custom apparel decoration via embroidery, screen printing, and direct-to-film (DTF) printing; sign and banner fabrication; sticker and label printing; and commercial printing of business cards, flyers, and hang tags. The team also offers graphic design support for logo creation, artwork cleanup, and print-ready file preparation, and sources promotional products such as drinkware, bags, and pens for client campaigns.

Clients span construction, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, and landscaping trades, as well as hospitality businesses, schools, clubs, sports teams, healthcare clinics, and wellness centers. The company also supports trade-show and corporate-event coordinators with branded giveaways, signage, and printed materials, and assists out-of-state firms launching a Boise location with a full suite of launch materials.

Brand Bros emphasizes a design-forward approach that blends strategy with creativity, consistent brand execution across all touchpoints, and reliable service marked by clear communication and on-time delivery. The firm positions itself as a long-term partner that grows with its customers, managing projects from initial concept through proof approval to final production and local delivery.

name: Brian Hubel
old_description: ​Take a peek at the custom furniture I design and create one piece at a time.
about:
Brian Hubel operates Hubel Handcrafted Interiors Inc. from Colorado Springs, Colorado. The business, founded by Brian A. Hubel, builds custom furniture one piece at a time and also offers woodworking classes and shop services to other woodworkers.

The shop produces handmade tables, seating, storage, lighting, clocks, shelving, and wall art, each designed and fabricated by Hubel himself. In addition to custom commissions, he runs 1‑ to 5‑day woodworking classes at a local Woodcraft store and provides milling services such as planing, sanding, jointing, rip cutting, and cross cutting for customers who need stock preparation.

Hubel serves individual clients, interior designers, and woodworking students worldwide, shipping finished pieces and offering hands‑on instruction. The shop’s services are geared toward anyone needing precision milling or a custom‑built piece, from residential furniture to artistic wall installations.

Hubel describes his work as more than furniture—each piece represents decades of learning, experimenting, and artistic expression. He emphasizes that every item is made by hand with quality materials specifically for the client, setting the studio apart through personal craftsmanship and direct teaching.

name: Brick Mill Furniture
old_description: Built-to-order, designed for your space, and crafted for homes that value quality over trends.
about:
Brick Mill Furniture operates from Williamsport, Pennsylvania, a city once known as the lumber capital of the world. The company crafts each piece by hand in its local workshop drawing on the region’s woodworking heritage.

The shop produces made-to-order solid hardwood furniture for dining rooms, bedrooms, home offices, and living spaces. Every item is built from lumber milled on-site from sustainably sourced local logs, using traditional joinery techniques and durable finishes. Customers select wood species, dimensions, and details to fit their space. The company also offers an epoxy line for live-edge designs. Orders ship via free FedEx curbside delivery, with an optional white-glove service; some pieces require simple assembly with included tools.

Brick Mill sells directly to residential customers seeking heirloom-quality pieces, as well as to commercial clients outfitting offices with conference tables and desks. Its showroom serves local visitors, while the online store reaches buyers nationwide. The firm emphasizes design assistance and dedicated support for each project.

The business was founded on a promise to create furniture that lasts for generations, rejecting veneers and particle board in favor of solid wood and time-honored craftsmanship. Its differentiators include an owned lumber mill, full customization, and a focus on legacy-grade construction.

name: Brideau Sheet Metal
old_description: Custom-built parts and structures designed to fit your exact project needs and stand up to daily use.
about:
Brideau Sheet Metal & Fabrication, Inc. operates from Leominster, Massachusetts. The company traces its roots to the 1960s with a mission to build quality metalwork and stand behind every piece delivered. No founders are named and ownership structure is not disclosed.

The shop provides custom sheet metal fabrication, welding (MIG, TIG, spot, structural, repair, portable, on-site), water jet cutting, steel fabrication, and HVAC sheet metal work. Its 7,200-square-foot facility includes a 3-ton overhead bridge crane, a Flow water jet cutter, a 220-ton Baykal press brake with 10-foot capacity, a 40-ton Wysong press brake, a 10-foot Cincinnati shear, a CNC plasma table, and various hand brakes and rolls. The company handles projects from small custom parts to large structural assemblies.

Customers span paper and pulp processing, plastic processing, construction (HVAC components, flashings), general industrial services (maintenance, ventilation, production sheet metal, OSHA-compliant platforms and stairs), and custom copper sheathing. The client base includes facility managers, manufacturers needing prototypes and components, commercial contractors, industrial operations, and homeowners or builders.

Brideau emphasizes a true partnership approach—working with clients rather than just for them—and the ability to scale from precision repairs to heavy steel projects. Continuous investment in equipment and a skilled team trained in both traditional and modern techniques underpin its reputation for reliability across New England.

name: Bridgetown Natural Foods
old_description: founded to provide better products and service to the natural foods community.
about:
Bridgetown Natural Foods operates from its headquarters in Portland, Oregon, and a second facility in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee. The company was founded by Kelly Klock and Dan Klock after Kelly, while building a national granola brand, struggled to find a manufacturing partner that could meet her high standards for food quality. They established Bridgetown to provide better products and service to the natural foods community. Although the exact founding year is not disclosed, the company achieved B Corporation certification in 2014, indicating it was operational by that time.

Bridgetown designs and manufactures portable natural food snacks, offering product development, production support, and scalable supply chain solutions. The company runs production lines at both locations, with a 2026 expansion in Tennessee adding a new line and creating 237 jobs. Its output focuses on organic and plant-based foods, serving both entrepreneurial and established brands.

The company partners with natural, gluten-free, and organic brands, providing contract manufacturing and co-packing services that enable those brands to scale. Its customer base includes innovative product creators and established companies in the natural foods sector that share a commitment to quality ingredients.

Bridgetown differentiates itself through a mission-driven approach summarized by the slogan "We Make the Food We Want Our Families to Eat." As one of the first manufacturers to certify as a B Corporation, it undergoes a rigorous social responsibility audit every three years, measuring performance against environmental, social, and community impact goals. The company emphasizes a culture of humble, conscientious problem-solvers and invests in employee growth, with examples of team members advancing from production roles to leadership positions.

name: Bridgeview Manufacturing, LLC
old_description: We founded Bridgeview because we believed small manufacturers deserved someone rooting for their success.
about:
Bridgeview Manufacturing, LLC operates from Dalton Gardens, Idaho, in the state's panhandle region. The company was founded on the principle that small manufacturers deserve a partner invested in their success, though a specific founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed. Ownership details such as veteran or family status are not explicitly stated.

The shop specializes in custom wire harnesses and cable assemblies, offering services that span assembly, crimping, cutting and stripping wire, labeling, rework and repair, soldering, testing, and engineering support including first articles and prototypes. Production runs range from prototype through low-volume to full production, with no disclosed facility size or headcount.

Bridgeview serves customers in renewable energy, medical equipment, aerospace equipment, medical device manufacturing, and defense contracting. Its typical clients are innovators, engineers, and small manufacturers seeking to move designs from prototype to reliable production.

The company emphasizes hands-on collaboration, including willingness to visit customer workspaces to plan manufacturing support, and highlights its north Idaho location near UPS and FedEx hubs for convenient shipping. Its stated mission is to help small manufacturers navigate the prototype-to-production transition confidently.
